verdicts.reason: A has a clean vertical stack with no collisions and a prominent headline and CTA, but the bullets are out of order (1,4,3,2), the 'Find Solstice' tagline is dropped into the middle of the list, the circle sits off-axis to the right of the can, and the logo is pushed to the very bottom. B has the headline running over the circle, the tagline wedged between bullets, three bullets shrunk to tiny type on a ragged indent, a large dead gap under the can, and legal text crammed beside the logo pill.

A has the headline sitting on the circle, the tagline breaking up the reordered bullet list, and the product placed below the CTA and legal text, so the reading order is backwards. It also ends with an oversized logo pill that competes with the CTA. B has the same headline overlap and jumbled list, plus tiny, misaligned sub-bullets, a big empty band above the CTA, and squeezed legal text beside the logo, which makes it worse.

A puts the fine-print legal line at the very top above the headline, which inverts the hierarchy. Its headline overlaps the circle and the tagline still interrupts the reordered bullets, though product, CTA and logo stack sensibly below. B repeats the tiny, ragged-indent bullets, the misplaced tagline, the dead space under the can and the legal text cramped next to the small logo pill.
